method: Same as trends/analyze_earthdata.py grace(): land mascons only, monthly climatology removed, annual mean of years with ≥ 6 months, 2003–2025, 2017–2018 dropped (GRACE→GRACE-FO gap). Mann-Kendall original test + Sen's slope, α = 0.05. Colour is the Sen slope of each ~3° mascon, painted on the 0.5° CRI grid. Adjacent cells that share a mascon_ID are not independent.
dataset: JPL GRACE and GRACE-FO MASCON RL06.3Mv04 CRI (TELLUS_GRAC-GRFO_MASCON_CRI_GRID_RL06.3_V4)

colour_scale.reason: A few high-latitude glacier/ice mascons have Sen slopes of several tens of cm/year (mascon 308, about 61.75°N 137.75°W, −33.92 cm/yr). Clipping the colour scale at ±2 cm/yr makes the regional groundwater/soil-water signals in Spain, the Midwest and southern Canada visible. Unclipped slopes remain in this JSON.
